description:
Problem: #3430 made oracle-gate re-run on issue_comment edited and deleted events (oracle-gate.yml:20-21, :41, :47-49), so that withdrawing an accepted stand-in removes a gate success; the checker accepts only a never-edited comment (oracle_review_check.py:37-44). Unit tests cover the trigger and decision (test_oracle_gate_workflow.py:483-522). No live run has exercised the trigger. Under docs/agent/merge-authority.md:44-46 an agent may post a stand-in only when the owner names the PR and head in the current request; this item keeps all stand-in actions with the owner.

Outcome: one recorded live observation, or a recorded owner decision to rely on the unit tests.

Decision gates:
1. Owner action only. Agents never post, edit or delete stand-ins here. Ask the owner, next time a real stand-in is needed or on a PR the owner names, to edit (any change, even whitespace) or delete it after oracle-gate passes on it, then post a fresh stand-in if the PR should still pass. If the owner declines, record that and finish on the unit-test evidence.
2. Ordering. Following merge-authority.md:69-72, the PR stays unarmed before the stand-in is withdrawn. Do not dispatch the gate until the issue_comment-triggered run has completed and its status is recorded: a dispatch shares the PR's concurrency group with cancel-in-progress (oracle-gate.yml:41-42) and would cancel the run under observation. After recording, dispatch and observe as merge-authority.md requires before treating the PR as ready.
3. Never withdraw a stand-in on a merged PR: the merge digest would report a review gap.

Common guardrails: no stand-in approvals by agents, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. Durable text carries no tracker item IDs. No code changes.
